title: ChainSheets
tagline: A Collaborative DAO network for Publishing Research Papers and Mint Paper Access
description:
Traditional peer review involves experts evaluating submissions, still it faces issues like bias, delays, lack of transparency, and variable review quality. ChainSheets can evolve to next state-of-the-art DAPP for the research publications using blockchain for decentralized, transparent peer review, aiming to improve these aspects with idea of DAO,  reputation system and amazing Token Dynamics to rewarding contributions to the field for people participating GENUINELY in the network.
